azure.resourcegroups.deployments.title: Deployments (Microsoft.Resources/deployments) history
limitations: Every resource listed in properties.template.resources is actually created (a real PUT through the same ARM dispatcher, with [parameters('x')] / [variables('y')] resolved to literal values) — but there is no full template-language evaluation: no concat()/resourceId()/reference()/copy-loop support, and dependsOn is not topologically sorted (resources are provisioned in template order). Redeploy re-runs the stored template for real; Cancel honestly 409s, since every deployment here completes synchronously and is never still 'Running' by the time a Cancel call could reach it.

azure.resourcegroups.activity_log.title: Activity log
limitations: Only console/SDK-triggered mutations made since the simulation booted are recorded (no historical backfill), and `caller` is a fixed placeholder identity rather than a real signed-in principal.

azure.resourcegroups.access_control_iam.title: Access control (IAM) — role assignments, roles and checkAccess
limitations: Role assignments are real ARM resources scoped to the resource group they were created under (list + checkAccess only see assignments at or above that scope, same hierarchy inheritance and explicit-deny-wins semantics as the Entra RBAC engine), and the Roles tab + checkAccess cover the built-in Owner/Contributor/Reader/… roles plus any custom role definitions. But checkAccess is a standalone decision tool: no other ARM call in Vyomi consults it, so every other data-plane/control-plane operation still succeeds regardless of what is assigned. Deny assignments and classic administrators are always empty.

azure.resourcegroups.cost_management.title: Cost analysis, budgets and cost alerts, scoped to this resource group
